notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 9/21/25
notes.content: [p]This week I made a steady amount of progress scripting out the events for scenes I had written. It’s always so satisfying to see moments that started in my head, then made it to paper, finally come to life on screen. This update includes a few longer dialogue scenes than usual—one in particular that I worked on yesterday took almost the entire day to fully edit because of all its moving pieces. But now that it’s done, that’s one more big task crossed off the list![/p][p]On top of that, I have a very exciting announcement: [b]a new Bad Ends comic by Jun is currently in the works![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/89051afb3f7bad42714a26ecae8a06f3d6120ba5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This comic is based on the events of Chapter 3 of the Hunter route, imagining what would happen if Mila were to fall into the hands of Mayor Sholz…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/39feae8ff577cc48a95f56fa4ed66147738df052.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]There’s still more work to be done on it,[/b] but I’m looking forward to sharing the finished version with you all soon![/p][p]That’s all I have for this week—until next time, everyone![/p]

Until next week, everyone![/p]

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 8/3/25
notes.content: [p]This past week, I completed my full run of the Vampire Route to help clear up a few lingering details as I continue writing Chapter 4. During that playthrough, something stood out to me that’s been nagging for a while—specifically, the pacing at which Mila and her Pets receive weapon upgrades. It felt a bit too sparse in places, so [b]I’ve gone back and added a few more weapon chests to earlier areas[/b]. I also expanded the game’s database with several new weapons that will be introduced later in the story.[/p][p]Alongside that, a new item will be debuting in the upcoming update: the [b]Sapientia Laurel![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/942399841e7c3ef1b3a4dfd3d2fc8e002618c2fb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Until now, there hasn’t been a way to raise the Magic Attack stat with a Laurel, but that’s about to change. These new Laurels will be quite rare in the Hunter Route—replacing certain treasure locations—but they’ll be more common in the Vampire Route and even purchasable in select shops![/p][p][b]I also took some time to revisit and update one of my personal favorite illustrations in the game[/b]—Vampire Mila, curled up and cozy in her coffin. I’d never gone back to fix the missing belt holders on her pants until now, but more importantly, [b]I’ve created a new alternate version featuring Mila in her dark vampire route gown[/b]… except this time, she’s about to be staked?![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/c90270ee05e13a8c6987490d1bd7a2ea68ea94a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]All preview images are currently available to Tier 2+ patrons on the Crimson Veil Discord and will be going live on Patreon later this week![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j"]discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j[/url][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/c/MKRUdesign"]https://www.patreon.com/c/MKRUdesign[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, a quick heads-up:[b] there will be no update next Sunday,[/b] as I’ll be heading out on a short trip with friends! We’ll be visiting Epic Universe in Orlando, and I’m super excited to check it out. [b]That said, I’ve already scheduled some new art to go live next Sunday[/b], so patrons and Discord members will still have something to look forward to at the usual time.[/p][p]That’s all for this week—see you all once I’m back![/p]

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 6/29/25
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hey everyone! I’ve been working on a bunch of smaller things here and there this week. Primarily, I’ve sketched out some CGs that will be added in the next update, and I’ve also started tinkering with ideas for a future update. That’s right, I planning ahead for the future! The reason being that I wanted to start brainstorming ideas for it, but I wanted to get two specific designs done and on paper before I continued. Also, I just really was in the mood to draw them. Anyway. I did work on a few sketches that I can share this week. Both a bit different and you can see a snippet of them here:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/ac38fdbe5f581dbf25373dbc45b72388a28d900a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tier 3+ patrons on the Crimson Veil Discord[/b] have already seen the full images early in the [b]Shardforge Sanctum[/b] channel, where I post multiple works-in-progress regularly. I[b]f you haven’t joined yet, here’s the invite link:[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j"]discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I also wanted to share a preview of the dancer sketch I showed before, now with flat colors![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/4bdec2505424920e82f9d76cbb72f4aaf18d0693.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Pretty, right?[/b][/p][p]She is going to take a bit longer to finish since she will have several alternate versions, including different poses once she's done.[/p][p]In addition, [b]I have an update that actually affects the Hunter Route for a change[/b]! This week, [b]I went back and updated the battle backgrounds in the final dungeon[/b]. Check out the improvements:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/44d391ce35fc1dd25f5ba550841bca8153a71632.gif"][/img][/p][p]The originals were made with a primitive image generator and always felt a bit lackluster to me. While these new backgrounds are also generated, they look far closer to what I originally intended, instead of a blurry mess. There are a few other new backgrounds coming for certain scenes as well, but this should give you a solid idea of what to expect.[/p][p]Overall, I’ve been in a pretty calm headspace this week. My day job has been slow with summer rolling in, which has given me more time to brainstorm and focus creatively. Honestly, I’ve just really enjoyed drawing more lately. Working on commissions recently seems to have sparked my art motivation, and it feels good. I am considering a couple of other illustrations in the background, but I’ll keep quiet on those for now so I don’t get anyone’s hopes up too early.[/p][p]It’s been a good week, and I hope yours has been too. That’s all for this week. Until next time, everyone![/p]

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 6/22/25
notes.content: [p]This week, I focused on fleshing out the area of Fenrir Glade, Crescent Village specifically. A long time ago, I shared a very early concept of what this part of the world might look like in the Vampire Route, but my plans have changed quite a bit since then. [b]I’m happy to say most of the new Crescent City’s structure is built,[/b] and the old werewolf village has taken on a much more modern appearance![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/29ecb3fba5e2f87114b53916f51d30dbb850e263.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over the past century, Fallholt has made peace with the lycanthropes to the west, allowing them to thrive and upgrade their living spaces. They even opened a specialty shop in the village center where you’ll be able to buy some unique items to help you on your journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/63846d4d95dbde0353983d035efb8133886eb035.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition to Fenrir Glade, I also started importing and updating maps for the Lingrave Wastelands, which will play a role in this upcoming update. Since it’s still mostly barren at this stage (as any proper wasteland would be), I decided not to share screenshots just yet.[/p][p]Lastly, I want to give you a look at the recently introduced character Chryses—I’ve completed her character portraits and you can check them out below![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/d20f0c4a933d9969be1099fea689fb4935d2c961.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]I’ve got her other expressions available now for all $5+ patrons in the Crimson Veil Discord server’s Hall of the Hunters channel, with a Patreon post coming later this week.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Join the Crimson Veil Discord:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j"]discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patreon:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/c/MKRUdesign"]https://www.patreon.com/c/MKRUdesign[/url][/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for this week. Until next time, everyone![/p]

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 6/8/25
notes.content:
[p]It’s been a productive week on my end! I’ve been steadily posting completed commissions throughout the week, and as of yesterday, I’ve officially cleared out my queue. With that wrapped up, I [b]was finally able to shift gears and begin sketching for the next story chapter of the vampire route.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today, I have two character sketches to share with you. First up is a brand new face: [b]Chryses Sharpe[/b], a high-ranking member of the Knights of Friedrich—just beneath Eliza in the chain of command. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/817fd4c950dec34f5c5edacd251d7b39691663ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Calm, collected, and fiercely capable, Chryses uses a Cipher Gauntlet to channel spiritual “soul” energy into devastating concussive blasts, powerful enough to tear through both the undead and the living.[/p][p][/p][p]The second sketch features [b]a familiar character… in a brand new outfit.[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/23f54ccf7f6e110407826e019ca51f19c44079d2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Can you guess who it is?[/b] [/p][p]This upcoming update will delve deeper into her backstory, and I hope you’re looking forward to the new layers we’ll get to explore.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for this week. Until next time, everyone![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 6/1/25
notes.content:
First things first—[b]Crimson Veil version 5.6.3 is now live on itch.io and Steam! [/b]This update addresses a few minor bugs reported from the last release and also introduces a small but handy addition: an NPC who can take your Serenity item off your hands, since there previously wasn’t a way to remove it from your inventory.

I’m still making my way through the commission queue, but this week I also took some time to further outline the story for the next major update, which will return to the vampire route. The script still needs some refining, but I’ve made enough progress to start sketching out some characters and locking in the scenes I want to include.

All I’ll say for now is that a large portion of the upcoming content will take place in Fenrir Glade... make of that what you will.

That’s all for this week—until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 3/16/25
notes.content:
This week has been all about tackling smaller tasks and refining various aspects of the game. [b]I updated the in-game picture gallery, which now features a total of 161 illustrations![/b] I also completed the missing bad end scenes for the enemies in the Dryad quest, adjusted battle difficulty for some of the new enemies, giving them a better variety of attacks and stats for a more balanced experience. [b]Additionally, I created new character portraits for Eve[/b], adding fresh expressions for both her human and vampire forms.

On top of that, [b]I’ve added another quality-of-life improvement to the battle UI.[/b] Now, not only is the font for damage values updated to match the game’s main font, but [b]players will also get clear indicators when a skill is strong or weak against an enemy.[/b] Here’s a preview of how it looks in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/38456ac6f4c90a1cce5a351eedef02343359d1ca.gif[/img]

Weaknesses and resistances have always existed in the game, but they were often too ambiguous. This small update makes combat feel more intuitive by giving players better feedback on their attacks.
Lastly, [b]I want to share a final new illustration from this update[/b]—a snippet of Effie’s bite scene! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/4d8ddf04890a6140e91fe7748f401014161db8fd.jpg[/img]

[b]The full version is now available for all $5+ patrons[/b] in the Crimson Veil Discord server’s Hall of the Hunters channel, with a Patreon post coming later this week.

[b]Patreon:[/b] [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/c/MKRUdesign[/url]

That’s all for this week—until next time, everyone!

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/70a3d9fb3748fdcc20d470f06e2694b0db34b521.jpg[/img]

The full version is available now for my $5+ patrons[/b] in the Hall of the Hunters channel on the Crimson Veil Discord. 

[url=https://discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j]https://discord.gg/Mqz6WGn95j[/url]

notes.content:
This week’s focus has been on scripting the events of Liora's quest that I had written. Another week goes by, another progress update for you all. I updated the lore bible from last week to fill out some of the parts I hadn’t yet written. [b]I’ve gone back and updated every instance (I could find) of the name Satan and changed it to Sanguineus.[/b] Vampire mythology is often associated with Christianity, but aside from the use of crosses, I’d rather have my game’s lore follow its own rules and not mess with any real world religion or its figures. I think that goes without saying in a work of fiction, but I’d rather avoid the [i]“ Umm, actually…”[/i] comments.

[b]I have finished the layout of the Shrouded Academy. [/b]I still need to decorate the interiors as well as add in a few… [i]gimmicks[/i]. I will elaborate further on that in a future update. I’m sticking to a development schedule that works best for me. I’ve said this before, but I’m repeating it again for myself more than anything. notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 7/21/24
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This week I began working on something that I had been thinking about making for a long time. As a solo creator, it's hard for me to keep track of all the facts within my fictional world, especially as Crimson Veil continues to grow in its scope. To help catalog these details, [b]I have started writing a Lore Bible for the game.[/b] So far, I have added short bios for each of the characters, including facts that are not said explicitly within the game’s text, but help flesh them out. There’s also details such as each character’s full name, age, height, weight, and the nationality they are based on.

Crimson Veil takes place in the fictional world of Gaia Solvus. The areas players visit are inspired by European countries. I have not created an official map yet, as I feel it could limit me creatively, but I have still given each of the characters a nationality that can later be adapted to my world’s equivalent. 
[b]
This is a list that I am continuing to update as I go, [/b]but if you are interested in learning a bit more about the game’s world, you can read through it here:

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-AOjGl0T_98w26hfcQcRp6WCf_hwXU-k6KI5eVabc_Y/edit?usp=sharing]Crimson Veil Lore Bible[/url]

[b]Be cautioned however, that there are some facts that could be considered spoilers,[/b] so I recommend that you at least finish the main story before skimming through it. Also, I’m only human, so if I miss a fact or misstate something here, please let me know so I can address it. I’m trying to keep things consistent moving forward, and this side project will most certainly help with that! Also, if there are any details you think that I should add, let me know.

Another big task off the To-Do list this week! The previously mentioned Slime Queen quest has now been fully implemented into the game! Going into this update, I wasn’t really sure what I wanted to do with the new slimegirl content, aside from just really wanting to include it. I mostly had loose ideas and a character design to go with. This week I sat down to think about how I could differentiate this quest from the ongoing slime quest of the main route!

This quest is slightly more involved than going around whacking slimegirls for jellies. After obtaining the quest, discovering Queen Oozora’s location, and then defeating her, you’ll gain access to a new area which you will be able to frequent throughout the course of the game. [b]The Sticky Arena![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/bc2a4336c2ec276da1473117d38fe0f1071846eb.jpg[/img]

Indeed, this is an arena in which you are pitted against three randomly assigned Slimegirls. You can fight as many as you want or none at all, but defeating all three will yield a random prize! [b]These range from all manner of slime jelly, to exclusive optional equipment for your party![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/c8a7539ab2ce72ed343cf3c949c61fbe12f1e842.jpg[/img]

Seeing as you can use this arena as often as you like (for a paltry fee) [b]this is also another excellent location to work on improving your bond level with your Pets![/b]

Each of these slimy warriors is matched with your current level, much like with Ophelia, so depending on when you choose to tackle this quest, these lesser slimes could wind up stronger than the Queen! [b]Watch your back, because anyone defeated in the arena is added to the Queen’s slimy collective…
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/2c03fe69749e2fc143b651127ffab89b5eb16fd0.jpg[/img]

[b]I have the full version of this illustration currently up on my patreon for all $5 and up members! [/b]

[/url]

With the majority of new locations now constructed and fleshed out, this week I began scripting events for the scenes of the game. I can now make it to Fallholt without having to warp there with dev tools! While creating these events, one scene I decided to change from the script was Dorian’s backstory. This scene was originally just a conversation between him and Mila, but I decided to make it something more visually interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/f45059b79fe6b5f801dcb80132a9381a3c11f674.jpg[/img]

The scene now goes through different parts of Dorian’s life as he recounts his early days, to the moment he became a vampire, and beyond.

Other scenes have been added too, such as speaking with this depressed looking girl at a bar:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/2e097d4d046162ebad3f38e4b053a3dd7f16e916.gif[/img]

[i]Maybe she’ll come up again later in the story, I dunno…[/i]

I’d say scripting-wise, I’m about halfway done with the update. Going to spend this upcoming week working on the second half of the script as well as begin working on some additional illustrations. I’ve not decided on how many scenes I want to make illustrations for. I think it just depends on how much time I have between now and [b]my predicted release window of April[/b]. All of the character portraits however are now done and colored. The last one I needed to finish was for the woman, shown above. 

[b]I have her character portraits available to all my $5+ patrons, if you’d like a preview of her.[/b] I mean, if you’re into depressed girls, I guess…

[url=https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign[/url]

That’s all I’ve got to share with you this week. Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 1/21/24
notes.content:
Another week comes to an end and just a bit more has been added to Fallholt! Little by little, I’m adding more party character interactions to the world. For example, if a player has Seraphina in their party and interacts with NPCs and certain objects around the Fallholt Cathedral, you’ll get some unique interactions with her! I’m sprinkling these little optional dialogues for players to discover and to hopefully encourage changing their party up every so often. In some cases, you can even earn rewards [b]if you have the right party member with you![/b]

Aside from that, I’ve continued to flesh out the Fallholt Center of Commerce, namely, the second floor, which not only contains additional shops, but also [b]an area exclusively for those with a taste for blood.[/b]

[i]Sinister Sip Street[/i] is a dark alley which provides a unique service for the undead citizens of Fallholt: [b]Public Enthrallment.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/846bf6b95c94a39750b88f7365d5ddf30013571a.gif[/img]

Here, Mila can hire Helena, a public thrall of Fallholt, who for a price, offers her blood straight from the source. No Sanctusaid required! Visit her often, and she may even give you a special discount for being a loyal customer!

Public Thralls are closely protected by their bodyguards, as over indulgence is a threat they often face. Their bodies are altered over their various sessions and adapt to make them the perfect meal for a thirsty vamp. Their senses become heightened. Their heart beats quickly if they sense a vampire nearby, luring them and priming their own blood to be consumed. Even their blood’s flavour changes in subtle ways to be more appetising.

Of course, Public Thralls still enjoy the rush that comes with being bitten. In fact, they may enjoy it more than most.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/bf2fdb7b8c8f89210876437fe35df311c6af6e0c.jpg[/img]

Right now, [b]I have Helena’s character portraits available to all my $5+ patrons.[/b] This preview is 26 alts, including uncensored nude versions. 

[url=https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign[/url]

I hope you all like her. This is an idea I had been looking forward to implementing since I returned to the Vampire Route!

That’s all I’ve got to share with you this week. Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 1/14/24
notes.content:
Howdy everyone! To everyone else who had to return to work this week, I hope the transition back was smooth. Mine was okay, though I still wish I could sleep in until 10.

[b]I decided to go back and edit the intro of chapter 3-V[/b] as I felt that the transition from the last chapter was rather weak. I also added an additional mandatory scene with Dorian before you are allowed to rest in the coffin to proceed. As it stands, he has very few worthwhile lines in the story, similar to Amber, pre-chapter 3 in the main route. He will be getting more presence in the story as it goes on.

I’ve also made an adjustment to sparring with Ophelia. [b]For balance purposes, I’ve added a level cap for training.[/b] What this means is if you surpass a certain level while you are at a point in the story where it would be too high, you will no longer be able to train with Ophelia for BP. In chapter 1-V for example, the level cap would be 15. If you pass that, Ophelia will say she’s tired, until you proceed to the next story segment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/7851b24aac3d85d7d1b66c1a29aa791da29ee481.jpg[/img]

I’ve also added in a bit more for the new Slime Queen side quest. I added her cave somewhere in the world and I've also finished her sprite and character portraits. [b]This Slime Queen’s name is Oozora.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/b91b23406adadc708aec45ea3f032fa99d15dfe1.jpg[/img]

I added a bit more [i]weight[/i] to her design. I think it better distinguishes her as a Queen compared to the other slimegirls. I went for a motherly, caring look. As for her personality, well, she certainly has that going for her… as well as a few other traits some may see as… concerning. I have all of Oozora's character portraits available as a preview for my $5 and up Patrons. Check ‘em out, if you wish.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign[/url]

I’ve still got plenty to do, so I’m going to get right back to work! Until next time everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 12/31/23
notes.content:
We’ve reached the end of another year. This year has been one I have fully dedicated to working on the vampire route and not much will be changing in 2024, at least as far as the game is concerned. [b]I’ve begun putting in place some of the early cutscenes for the new update.[/b] This includes the reveal of the latest threat, Sigrun Hellige.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/4d04ec7074668ced3f8789c85b51557251fdc8be.jpg[/img]

Sigrun is an [i]Estelle[/i]. They are an elf-like race from Edrestenn, with a natural affinity to light magic and an innate immunity to vampiric infection. Though the Estelle have been a secluded race for some time, they have resurfaced to create an alliance with Fallholt. Sigrun is not only a capable ranger with vast years of combat experience, she is also the Estellian ambassador of Edrestenn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/12db5936bb6bd143aaa1de6d41d61b2ced2a9cb3.jpg[/img]

Sigrun herself is calm and enigmatic. She hides her true intentions behind a veil of calculated professionalism, making her a challenge to strike a simple conversation with. [i]Perhaps she’s just introverted? Or could there be more to her? [/i]

[b]I’ve completed her character portraits, so all of my $5+ patrons can get a better look behind the curtains of her personality. [/b]I still have more to draw of her, but this preview should give you an idea of what to expect with her.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign
[/url]

With that being said, I wish you all the best in the new year! Let it be a year of progress and prosperity for all!

Until next week everyone. Happy New Year!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 12/10/23
notes.content:
One of the nagging issues in the vampire route that many of you had rightly mentioned in the recent satisfaction survey was the tedium of increasing your Pet’s bond level. [b]This week, I attempted to patch that issue, and here is what I’ve come up with.[/b] Now whenever your Pet notifies that they wish to speak with you, you’ll be asked if you would like to quickly warp back and view the conversation. Afterward, you’ll be returned to the spot you were previously in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/a5f71289d0bd1b020bd603f23379e27aa29357fc.jpg[/img]

I was hesitant to add this initially, since warping at certain points may not make sense. But I feel the convenience of this feature outweighs the negatives. Also, since this prompt can appear in many different locations and situations where warping may create a conflict,[b] I’ve set it to autosave before being asked to warp in case an issue occurs. [/b]The player can then reload and choose not to warp instead. Messy, but necessary.

In other news, the construction of the new Fallholt continues![b] I wanted to restore some features that were until now, only available in the main route.[/b] Armour customization will be available upon reaching chapter 3, finally giving your gems their additional use. Also returning will be an option to purchase and use Serenity, with all the benefits and consequences that come with it. Not that there were any real benefits to using it… until now. 

[b]While using the drug, Mila’s attack and agility will now temporarily increase by about 40%.[/b] Pretty significant if you stack it with other buffs. Although the consequences of using it are great, as I’m sure you all know… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/3d06d1bf884a563f72eee60be25699cab20de379.jpg[/img]

This is also a great time to mention that more of your actions in the main route will affect the vampire route. For example, [b]if you never accept the Tragic Bride quest in the main route, your Serenity dealer will turn out to be a familiar face…[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/e178a351e6e25f7bc044d2454486fd7f492cd307.jpg[/img]

That’s just one example of the small changes your actions in the main route can affect! That being said, I needed to update the artworks for the Serenity ending and [b]all of my $5 and up Patrons can check them out now.[/b]

[url=https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign[/url]

That’s all I have to share with you this week. Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 12/3/23
notes.content:
This week I made a goal of completing at least 1 small task for the game every day, and I managed to pull it off! I settled on the names for the next two chapters and created title graphics for them, created new sprites for some characters, cleaned up some bugs I discovered while playing through the android port, sketched out 2 more characters, finalized the character portrait of another, and (nearly) finished mapping one of the bigger and more interesting areas of the next update!

Fallholt has gone through some extensive social changes over the last century. As Mila and the player will discover, [b]Fallholt has become a thriving city which has integrated vampires into their society![/b] Indeed, Fallholt has become a city where vampires and humans live alongside each other, ruled by the vampiric [b]Queen Anja.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/cad92e43e67f4a7d488808dd20f3bbb3f15a327e.jpg[/img]
 
Though initially a controversial decision, the current generation of mortals within Fallholt have grown to see their vampiric neighbors as equals rather than as monsters. [b]All turnings must be sanctioned by the Queen herself and the creation of ghouls is highly illegal.[/b] To enforce these policies, the Queen established the Knights of Friedrich and recruited vampire hunters to slay those that choose to live against her laws.

Indeed, Fallholt is a city where vampires can live and even shop freely! The newly established Fallholt Center of Commerce is open 24 hours a day, employing vampires at night and humans during the daylight hours. With a constant flow of income throughout the day, the economy of Fallholt is more prosperous than at any other point in it’s history!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/0441eddf12932e3ba3d87817beda301d4930f4fc.jpg[/img]
 
[b]The center acts as an upscale shopping mall, with multiple stores and activities to spend your hard earned gold. [/b]I’ve made the area feel bustling by adding in multiple NPCs that go in and out as you shop. This touch really makes the center come alive, even if the shop owners you’ll interact with are well, “dead”.
I hope this short teaser of the next chapter has intrigued you and left you with many questions. I can’t guarantee they’ll all be answered, but my goal is to make revisiting this familiar city an interesting trip!

Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 11/26/23
notes.content:
I’m back! I hope any fellow Americans had a restful Thanksgiving weekend. Rest is mainly what I had been doing this week, as I came home with a pretty bad flu. It’s been nothing but wheezy coughs for me and my throat is pretty sick of it. Thankfully, I’m still able to do shopping from the comfort of my bed and I picked up a basic android tablet on the cheap to finally try out Crimson Veil’s android port for myself. [b]Big shoutout to the66 for making the Android port.[/b] Playing my game on a handheld, in the comfort of my bed totally changes the experience for me. 

This is the first time I am playing the main route from start to finish without skipping over anything. Playing the game while divorced from my pc to make on the fly changes allows me to enjoy the game for what it is, flaws and all. I don’t want to toot my own horn too much, but so far, it's been hard to put down. I’m really proud of what I have been able to do with this game and it fills me with joy that I was able to get it done at all. Once again, thanks so much to the66 for bringing us this port and allowing me to enjoy my game in this way.

Anyway, enough gloating… Despite feeling sick, I did make progress on the game this week, with some sketches. [b]Here are two illustrations depicting some optional characters that can be found in the next update. [/b]A wight, and a woman covered in bites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/ed4208151592db4c3be51161ec47931c43909992.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/7003a5491fa7acb1fcd6e6fdc86a838fed5cf21a.jpg[/img]

What’s the context behind the inclusion of these two? Well they can both be found within a new area found within Fallholt which I will get into next week. I’m curious to hear your predictions about them. Maybe your thoughts align with mine… or not! 

That’s all I have to share with you this week. Until next week, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 11/12/23
notes.content:
For the past two update cycles, I have been slowly acclimating myself back to the vampire route in terms of its world. While I had an end goal for the story in mind, the middle had been shaky for the longest. After plenty of time to brainstorm, I’ve come up with an interesting premise for the next story chapter, which I’ll slowly reveal over this update cycle.

What I can share for now, are [b]some updated maps.[/b] Do you see any new changes in the northern region? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/42ea6dbed2d39b12cfac3f8e84ad37c662f91a4b.gif[/img]

[b]The story will take Mila back to Fallholt[/b], which has seen numerous changes over the century. Technology has grown and its populace has expanded. However, some timeless structures remain the same. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/0f8358d1c27dddb6fe132335b93e3d5ff13e2e45.gif[/img]

I’m sure you are curious about some of the new buildings. I didn’t want to simply port over the same map from the main route with a few changes, but I’ll elaborate more on that the further I get into development. The Fallholt area is one of my favorites in the game and putting a new spin on it is something I’m looking forward to making and sharing with you all!

That’s all the news I have to share with you for now, but I also want to announce that [b]there will be no update next Sunday[/b] as I will be out on a week-long trip with some of my friends! Weekly updates will resume as normal on Nov 26 at the usual time, 8PM EST.

Also, also, if you haven’t had the chance yet, [b]I’m currently hosting a player satisfaction survey for Crimson Veil.[/b] It’s about [u]20 questions[/u] and should take no more than 5-10 minutes to complete. The survey is entirely anonymous, so feel free to share any of your wildest ideas! Your help has already contributed to the recent updates, so I’d like to hear what else you all can offer me. The link to it can be found below:

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScvsSyUwzyAUrilu-xhD5x_Iy-C351GsxSF6EKTmtWAeIQm7w/viewform]Crimson Veil Survey #2[/url]

Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 10/1/23
notes.content:
Hey, all of you wonderful individuals! Here’s what’s new in this week’s update!

A small but impactful quality of life change has been added![b] The weapon slots for your Pets are no longer locked![/b] This change of course means that exclusive weapons for them can be discovered over the course of the game. As of this update, two new weapons can be found. This change will hopefully incentivize the use of multiple Pets for different situations. Also, Lauren who previously fought without a weapon, now starts with a basic cleaning broom! …Well, she can use it as a staff to channel her magic, at least.

Next, I'm happy to announce the completion of the last substantial chunk of writing I had left. Seraphina's support conversations are now completely written, scripted and tested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/78e006ab37b098df90607e6c7f8dad207d4c4762.jpg[/img]
 
On Monday I had trouble concentrating, but I managed to pull through over the course of the week and get it done. Working on the game while at my local library was a big help. The place was recently refurbished and had a great, calm atmosphere. I want to return there soon.

On the game’s side, [b]I just have a few more things to get through before release.[/b] I need to rebalance the boss fight, finish the enemy placements in the dungeon, update the dev room to include all the new items, cheats, and skips for this version, and finally test the scenario from start to finish. I do however have two more pieces of art to finish, which is what I plan on prioritizing this week.

For this week’s art teaser, I present you with this: [b]Seraphina’s max affection scene.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/3eab2c6328e492b77a9a9bde69bdad915fb44fb0.jpg[/img]
 
This preview is a set of 8 alts and as always, is available to view for all of my $5+ patrons.
[url=https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign[/url]

I still plan on releasing the game this month, but [b]it’s likely going to release late in the month for Patrons and then early November for everyone else. [/b]This is to ensure I have plenty of time to test and iron out any flaws I encounter right upon release. Thanks to everyone for being patient!

Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 9/17/23
notes.content:
Greetings, Crimson Veil enjoyers. Welcome back to another weekly update!

[b]This week was spent catching up on some of the smaller tasks I had yet to do.[/b] For example, I filled out the dungeon with environmental details, and treasures. I finished adding in the pending level 4 patrons as NPC characters (special thanks to you all!)[b] I also had to put in some thought in creating unique skills for Bianca and Seraphina.[/b] I had to think to myself, what is their role in combat? What would make a player want to pick a specific Pet over another (aside from just choosing their favorite). In that regard, I made both of their roles a bit more niche. 

Bianca for example, learns moves that can give an enemy a weakness to a particular element. She is also capable of giving Mila half of her own SP, providing Mila with crucial gas in a tough battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/b9c14c00beabdf6615f34d647bb0de8451fc5e4f.jpg[/img]

Seraphina on the other hand, has a skill which acts like Aeriseth’s summon skill, reducing a single enemy’s remaining health by 30% as well as her own. Definitely a powerful opening skill which grows weaker over a longer battle. She is also capable of sacrificing herself for a full heal to Mila as well as a temporary buff to attack and defense. Both skills are useful, but cost a fair amount of SP, so be sure to use them wisely.

[b]I'm working hard to finish the last few sketches to have everything done in time for the October release. [/b]Here’s a preview of the latest sketch I’ve done. This one is for Seraphina’s bad ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/5c51085ee77b0fa1520f05d7bb870f3fa1fab72c.jpg[/img]

That wraps up what I have to share with you all today. Thanks again to everyone who sent me well wishes for my birthday. Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 9/10/23
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I hope you're all doing well!

After finishing what was left of Bianca’s content, I shifted focus to Seraphina and her quest. The dungeon layout is complete and I just need to tweak some of the puzzle elements and furnish the environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/071bf35d588ebdc74d6aca916b9374c736edd0ad.jpg[/img]

Some more scenes have been scripted and I think I’ve created a challenging boss out of her. [b]Seraphina’s power of light will slowly drain Mila (and companion) of her HP, adding additional tension to the fight.[/b] If you are at a lower level, you will definitely want to bring a Pet to help you in this fight.

[b]Seraphina’s support conversations and bad ending are the last major pieces of writing I have left.[/b] To be honest, I felt stuck with where I wanted her character to go. While writing the boss scene leading up to her bite, I got an epiphany. It required me to go back and create new character portraits, [b]but now the conversations have the capability to be…sexier. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/06603c82ae2a2a2de2c2ff39023b11200772fa66.gif[/img]

Outside of her initial fall and corruption, [b]I want to explore the sexual deviousness of this wicked, holy woman.[/b] While I enjoy writing support conversations, I realize that the conversation tends to lean towards wholesome rather than arousing. While I think that’s worked well for the characters I’ve written for so far, I think there’s a portion of the player base that’s looking for more T&A out of these conversations.

One other quick thing [b]I’d like to share with you all is this sketch of a new enemy type! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/2f1fa3a743101d53d06811cefdf03a237d11a7e5.jpg[/img]

I’d been brainstorming ideas for new mook enemy types to add to the vampire route, since fighting vampire hunters can get pretty repetitive, even if their designs are varied. [b]I came up with the idea of adding a hunter enemy that focuses on a singular skill type.[/b] This hunter focuses on Axe skills. Eventually, there will be an enemy type for Knives, Bombs, Crosses, and Silver Bullets too! [b]This enemy type will not be added in this update[/b] as I already have my hands full, but will appear in the next update, which will advance the vampire route’s story.

[b]I’ll be taking it easy this upcoming week, to celebrate my birthday with some friends.[/b] I have some fanart unrelated to Crimson Veil that I’ve meant to finish, but haven’t had the time to. That being said, I want to announce that I plan on releasing the next update some time in October. The last big hurdle is finishing up the art and writing the bad ending scenes, so expect to see those in the coming weeks leading up to the update’s release.

But that’s all I have for you this week. Until next time, everyone!

Hey everyone! I hope you're all enjoying your extended weekend if you're in the U.S., just like I am!

This week has been quite productive for me on the game development front. I'm thrilled to share that [b]I've managed to write all of Bianca's scenes[/b]. And, they're not just written but also completely scripted, except for one slightly more complex scene, which I plan to dive into tomorrow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/5940b887527698f6c542968f2f37fb62e8d14d07.jpg[/img]
 
Writing for Bianca was a unique challenge because, among all the characters in the game, she's the one the players know best. I wanted to avoid the risk of it feeling repetitive, so [b]I decided to explore a different, unseen side of Bianca.[/b] This approach breathed new life into her character, and once I started, the creative ideas just kept flowing. To top it off, I've even finished the colors on Bianca's max affection illustration!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/8e7246452cb709a20d16b918d7fa4a19008dd90b.jpg[/img]

$5 and up Patrons can check out the full version right now. Your support is greatly appreciated!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign[/url]

But that's not all; [b]I've also begun scripting some of the earlier scenes for the Shattered Sanctity Quest.[/b] This questline is going to be an exciting one, and I can't wait to see where it takes our characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/af172730c3c718ed1a665b343e3ef1ab62104894.jpg[/img]
 
Seraphina has become one of the few characters who I prefer in her human form. [i](She'd probably look great as an ancient vampire...)[/i] So, to showcase some more scenes of Seraphina as a human,  I created additional expressions for the Nun NPC so that she would have someone to bounce a conversation off of… Until she meets with Mila, of course.

Lastly, while I have continued to write lore entries, I've been pondering the role of the church in this new world. Its history and connection to the kingdom of Fallholt have been fascinating to think about in my spare time. Definitely happy about making this quest because its potential for expansion into other aspects of the vampire route is great!

Thank you all for your continued support and enthusiasm for the game. Your feedback and encouragement fuel my creativity, and I can't wait to bring you more exciting updates soon!

Until next time, everyone!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 8/13/23
notes.content:
How’s everyone doing this week?

As for me, [b]I was really in the mood to color Sigrun this week[/b] and tweak some small things in her design, such as her face. Her eyes were previously too big, and while I found them kind of cute, it didn’t really fit the personality I was going for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/b84221492876f57e5456a40bbe22dacde8561318.jpg[/img]
 
[i]She won’t be showing up in the game until the following update[/i], but I still wanted to share the flat colors with you all anyway. I’ve been experimenting with shiny and blushed skin with my characters lately. I really like the effect it has on characters with relatively pale skin, such as Sigrun. This is the first time I’ve tried adding some blush to ears and I like it's subtle effect. Skin texture is an area in my art where I’d like to improve the most, since I tend to hyper focus on it, when looking at other artists' work.

As for Besilly Cathedral, [b]I decided I wanted to expand on this older area[/b]. Since I did pretty much all I could do with this place in the main route, I decided to create a new area and expand the lore of the cathedral itself.

You’ll start off by entering the cathedral through the previously inaccessible second floor. From here you can get a quick view of the familiar church below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/2c8143485d85ff784313e2e7729b49c5a2ffdbf9.jpg[/img]
 
But below the cathedral lies a large underground sewer known as [b]Blutig Waterway.[/b] The waterway harbors an inner sanctum, a place where holy ones can meditate to restore their light powers and where many ancient rituals once took place. There are many dark secrets within this place that members of the clergy have taken to their graves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/7f3754efce3729ad0dc39a72b2e156e2d22d8516.jpg[/img]
 
[b]The origin of this place dates back centuries and is the birthplace of the local town’s bloody superstitions…[/b]

I hope this small taste of the next update has piqued your interest! Until next time, everyone!

Hello again, everybody!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/172cf4d63d82eefa1006263641e84e63888396ec.jpg[/img]

For starters, Ophelia will be able to join you as a playable character as early as the start of Chapter 2. However, [b]increasing her Bond Level will no longer change what items she has in stock.[/b] That will now change based on story progression, for balance reasons.

Ophelia’s Bond Level can still be increased by sparring with her. And speaking of which, [b]her battles have been modified too.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/5bd1bfbd1be5239c017e89cad5ec9a009d7c8b71.gif[/img]
 
[b]You can now see what level Ophelia is when fighting her.[/b] Her level matches yours and with higher levels comes newer skills that she can use with or against you. This should make her a reliable training buddy throughout the course of the game.

I’m still writing her support conversations, however. This week has been difficult to sit down and  concentrate on drafting dialogue, so I made progress where I could. Adding in newer party members to the game comes with a lot of work to the game’s systems. Things such as individual “most liked food/alcohol” values, date conversations, Pet progress conversations… Several common events need to be tested and updated. While I did create these systems in a manner that makes them easy to update, it’s still rather tedious and requires extensive testing.

But enough complaining from me… [b]I’m going to try and get the remaining conversations for Ophelia done this week and then begin working on the updated Besilly Cathedral[/b]. I came up with an interesting idea for the place this week to make revisiting this old location feel fresh once again.

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 7/16/23
notes.content:
Happy Sunday, everyone!

[b]A big congratulations to Potomiani, the winner of the User Submitted Contest #9, for their submission of “Shattered Sanctity”![/b] There were a lot of really close races in this recent contest, so clearly every submission had its fans. I would like to urge all that did not win to[b] hold on to their ideas for the next contest![/b] Consider a redraft or something that can make your idea even more compelling for next time! Also, be sure to check back frequently for updates on when the next round will take place! As for me, I’ll soon be getting to work on crafting Potomiani’s idea to the game!

On the game development side this week, I’ve implemented a requested quality of life feature, exclusive to the vampire route. [b]The amount of BP (Blood Points) you’ve accumulated will now appear on your over world HUD!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/08e22bfdc6000c5c8e5f3ba046257300a314d3fb.jpg[/img]
[/b]
[i](This feature will only appear in the vampire route, not any of the vampire bad endings, since it’s unnecessary. )[/i]

The BP gauge that appears on screen is actually a different plugin from the one I’ve been using for years and works separately from it (you may notice it fades away at a slightly different timing in-game). Even still, I tried to match the style of the gauge so that it wouldn’t stand out too much. I think this will be a greatly appreciated change so that players can better see how their actions are furthering their strength. It was never really clear to players that sparring with Bianca or Ophelia would grant BP, for example. The BP system is also now briefly explained early into the beginning of the route.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/834ca04e8bc29e0b7c19eafea1f6a8aa574e64e6.jpg[/img]
Oh, and I’ve added another neat feature which is available whenever you are playing as vampire Mila. [b]If you have the “Bat Form” skill unlocked, you can now press PGUP to quickly turn into a bat (and back).[/b] I liken it to setting the bike to select in the old Pokémon games. It makes faster movement much more convenient.

Well, It’s back to work for me then. Thanks again to everyone who participated in the contest and I hope you’ll join in on the next one! Until next week!

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 4/2/23
notes.content:
Hello again everyone! I've got an exciting update for you this week!

[b]A highly requested feature will be implemented in the vampire route! [/b]I'm happy to announce the Pets system is getting expanded! [b]Specific pets will now be able to join Mila in battle![/b] Let me give you a rundown on how I will implement this change in game...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/9dddbb4a1730587b09c1312130a55eeb40602fc3.jpg[/img]
 
As of this update, three different Pets will be able to join Mila: [i]Vicilla, Lauren, and Edith[/i]. [b]You may only have one ally with you at a time[/b] and you can visit their locations to swap with them when you want. Each of these allies serve a different role in battle. [b]Vicilla[/b] is a berserker with high power, though at the cost of being uncontrollable. [b]Lauren[/b] is nimble and can cast healing spells and buffs. [b]Edith[/b] can distract enemies and tank hits better than other allies. Each ally's level scales to whatever Mila's level is, so even if you don't use them, they won't be left behind in power.

However, [b]by raising their affinity, you can unlock stat increases and additional skills for them![/b] A prompt will appear once you have reached a certain affinity threshold and that is your cue to go speak with them at their designated location to raise their level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/a6df8d16b5ecca7be7c633496023aa68025c97ac.jpg[/img]
 
Affinity can be raised in multiple ways: Defeating enemies together, completing quests with them, and giving them food. [i]Due to this specific change, all food items may only be used outside of battle.[/i] However, [b]the best way to increase their affinity is by taking them out on a dinner date![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/0c3d74af4612eabe7d4899b5d0196f3a4f671960.jpg[/img]
 
By taking an ally with you to the new Humilem Bistro, you will be able to order food and drinks for your date. [b]Each girl has specific tastes,[/b] which you may infer from their support conversations. [b]If you purchase a meal that suits them, you'll receive a larger affinity bonus at the end of the date![/b]

Be aware, although your allies are vampires, they aren't "immortal". They can still get defeated in battle!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/ec68ecc37a860504cd994d9ed90f480263ad12a5.jpg[/img]

[b]When you obtain your first ally, you will also unlock the "Resurrect" Skill[/b], which will revive an ally at a hefty cost to HP and SP. Allies regen HP and SP slower than Mila and generally have lower stats. Their combat options are also much more limited. Most concerning, if Mila falls in battle, her ally will immediately join in her demise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/fd3cd0baeeb4901e71b6e11f2de670fda1c4f31c.jpg[/img]
 
[i]Mila's servants must ensure their Mistress survives no matter the cost![/i]

This particular update to the Pets system has taken a bit of time for me to get working properly and there is still a good amount of tweaking I'll have to do to the difficulty to get it right and not feel overpowered. I still have a lot of additional writing to do for each of these support conversations, but I feel that the effort will be worth it, because [i]the main appeal of the vampire route is going around and turning girls into vampires[/i]. It would feel pretty shallow if you were unable to explore some of the girls you turn, so I hope that the players will create a bond with their favorite girl and get to know them!

[i]Before anyone asks[/i], [b]this dating sim aspect of the Pets system will only be for these three characters [u]for now[/u].[/b] I wanted to create three different class archetypes for the allies and with how I have currently designed this system and with all the writing I still have to do... It was just too much to include in one update. Bianca and Ophelia will get their time to shine as an ally eventually. I have specific plans for Bianca actually, that I wish I could share, but you'll all just have to stick around to find out!

[i]*Whew* [/i]That was quite a lot to go through! I hope you all are excited for this change and are looking forward to interacting with these new allies. One last thing to share before I end it for this week. I finished the wolfy version of the Vicilla art from two weeks ago. [i]Here's a small teaser:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/51cd5f023852d89dbb2019e2e3500df10704faf6.jpg[/img]
 
[b]The full version is currently available for all my $5 and up patrons[/b]. Check it out if you want to help support me.

[url=]https://www.patreon.com/MKRUdesign[/url]

That's all I have to share with you this week. Until next time everyone!

notes.content:
This week I played through the current build of the vampire route for the first time in what feels like forever. I fixed some small things that should have been addressed earlier. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/8101313d6d869bba7c6f89d9b87f1e0a8c558a3c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: WEEKLY UPDATE!! 3/19/23
notes.content:
A few bugs from the most recent version had been nagging at me, so this week I attempted to address them. The first, was Aeriseth's boss fight in the casino not working as intended. This error came about from me thinking I had a redundant common event in the data base and overwriting it with the new Blackjack NPC within the casino. [i]This is why you don't mess with code you haven't touched in years, folks.[/i] Thankfully, I had a back up of the original event on my old laptop and I[b]'m happy to say the event has been restored to normal.[/b] I even spent a good amount of time getting my ass kicked in Blackjack to ensure the scene played out properly, as well as the other encounters with her afterward.

The second bug has been a bit trickier to find a solution to. [b]Some have reported the game's graphics freezing while the game seemingly continues to run in the background.[/b] There's no concrete trigger for it and it can cause a player to lose progress, so it's quite frustrating. I've read a few RPG Maker devs run into this issue and I've run into it myself on occasion. I've seen answers range from it being a driver issue, to vsync issue, but nothing so far seems conclusive. This is a bug I have a pin on and if any of you know of a solution or where to point me towards, I'd love to hear it. Until then, I'll keep on digging.
Onto one of the smaller tasks done this week, some updated graphics for enemy types.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/4809df2b5527fe3ef2add0b161c936a3abdcaf8e.jpg[/img]

[b]Human Maids can be encountered and corrupted into vampires and ghouls.[/b] The same goes for the armored soldier enemies, which will appear during the "Countess in Crimson" side quest. The maid's sprite graphics have been updated to show her bright new emerald colored eyes. The maids won't put up much of a fight, but the soldiers will be a challenge to defeat!
And lastly I was doing some supplemental writing to flesh out some character backstories. I'm tracking it all in a notebook so I don't miss anything. [i]Some of these details I'm writing now may not be shown for a while,[/i] but [b]one of the characters you will be able to interact and learn about is Vicilla.[/b] She will added as a new Pet in the latest update and you'll be able to view a new illustration of her once you build up bond with Mila. Here's a quick teaser:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43657976/3775fcccdc3f7b304e55d3e88344100340f7936c.jpg[/img]
[i]All my Tier 2 and up Patrons can view the full image now if they like.[/i]

That's all I have to share with you this week. Until next time, everyone!
